import json, resource, time
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.engine.temporal_workflow import workflow
from nisayon.engine.io import write_json
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (20, 21))
started = time.process_time()
root = Path("artifacts/engine-integration-001/temporal-integration-001/combined-deadline-001")
assert not root.exists(), "Never overwrite an attempted comparison"
execution, assessment = workflow(Path("docs/experiments/results/temporal-integration-001/frozen-combined-deadline.v1.json"), root, Path.cwd())
size = sum(p.stat().st_size for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
report = {"assigned": 24, "complete": assessment["complete_records"], "legacy_contracts": assessment["reference_contract_counts"], "assigned_contracts": assessment["assigned_contract_counts"], "process_cpu_s_before_final_write": time.process_time() - started, "retained_bytes_before_final_write": size, "allocation_cpu_s": 20, "allocation_bytes": 16 * 1024**2, "new_simulator_executions": 0, "boundary": "New exposed software policy comparison; identical combined conventional and selected remedies. Original comparisons and modes unchanged; robot task progress unmeasured."}
write_json(root / "capture.json", report)
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
assert assessment["complete_records"] == 24
assert sum(p.stat().st_size for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file()) < 16 * 1024**2
cost_boundary: wall time for this command; human time and external costs unmeasured
